title: Operator: refuse empty reason on reject_execution

investigation.trigger: standing instruction to keep shipping real, tested improvements to the Command Hub Operator Console
investigation.finding: an explicitly-passed empty-string or whitespace-only `reason` was silently folded into the same undefined branch as an omitted reason, with no signal that the caller's string carried no actual content; `reason` itself is correctly optional per the tool's own schema and stays that way

fix.mechanism: refuses before touching Supabase or resolveExecutionId() when args.reason is a string that trims to empty; an omitted/undefined reason is unaffected

live_verification: not performed — autopilot_reject_execution requires an authenticated exafy_admin thread and a real awaiting_approval execution; this session has no live Operator Console access. The next real signal is a real call with an explicit empty reason being refused on staging.
